response: {"verdict":"unsupported","reason":"S110 says the Engineering Workstation provides approved tools for searching, filtering and exporting event records, so the tools process records rather than provide them, and no sentence says the tools send event records to the Protection Relay Engineer; S194 only says the engineer reviews event records, with no stated source."}
